routes.label: Maximum independent set: space for approximation

axisSummary.x: Approximation exponent t for β=n^t, fixed as n grows
axisSummary.y: Leading bit-space exponent s; logarithmic factors suppressed
axisSummary.note: Both bounds have leading exponent s=2−t. Green and red are separated by a few screen pixels only for visibility; that offset does not encode a numerical gap. Logarithmic factors and exact finite-n ranges are retained below. Open endpoints mean fixed t<1 (algorithm) and fixed t<1/2 (lower bound), not inclusion of β=n or β=√n.
